FISHING LICENCE · NEW ZEALAND

New Zealand — Fish & Game fishing licence

Everyone who fishes for sports fish needs a licence, including children and visitors. Overseas visitors need a non-resident licence; Fish & Game licences do not cover Taupo.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • All anglers who fish for sports fish such as trout and salmon.
  • Overseas visitors must use the non-resident day or season option.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident adult daynon resident24 hours$39 NZD
Non-resident adult seasonnon resident1 October–30 September$273 NZD
Non-resident junior or child daynon resident24 hours$24 NZD
Non-resident junior or child seasonnon resident1 October–30 September$52 NZD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Designated waters licence
    Non-residents need the full-season licence plus the relevant designated-waters permission.
  • Sea-run salmon endorsement
    Where the regional rules require it.

Saltwater

No general sea fishing licence is required. Marine reserves, catch limits and local closures still apply.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Each angler must carry a valid licence; a guide does not replace the personal requirement.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry your valid licence.
  • Check the rules for the Fish & Game region.
  • Do not use felt-soled waders.

How to buy

Buy through Fish & Game's online licence service or a licence agent.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in New Zealand — Fish & Game?

Everyone who fishes for sports fish needs a licence, including children and visitors. Overseas visitors need a non-resident licence; Fish & Game licences do not cover Taupo.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in New Zealand — Fish & Game?

Non-resident adult day: $39 NZD; Non-resident adult season: $273 NZD; Non-resident junior or child day: $24 NZD; Non-resident junior or child season: $52 NZD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in New Zealand — Fish & Game?

Buy through Fish & Game's online licence service or a licence agent.
